text:
Type: aluminum dome pendant lamp
Use: focused light over a dining table, kitchen island or work desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: industrial, retro, modern
Materials: brushed aluminum shade and ceiling cup, black cord, white inner shade
Colors: silver aluminum, black, white inside
Shape: wide flared dome shade with a narrow neck, hangs on a long thin black cord from a matching ceiling cup, classic workshop silhouette, medium size and weight
Feel: crisp, utilitarian, cool, graphic
Goes with: dark or reclaimed wood tables, concrete, black metal chairs, white tiles; industrial or modern kitchens and dining rooms

product.name: FOTO
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E27 400 lumen globe opal white. View more product information Gives a directed light; good for lighting up for example dining tables or bar tops.
